hook: RIGHT JOIN: LEFT ka ulta, par log fir bhi [[LEFT hi]] likhte hain

slides.title: RIGHT = [[right ki saari]]
points: Left mein match nahi? Left columns **NULL**
slides.note: **Right** = JOIN ke **baad** likhi table. Yaad rakhne ka trick 😉

slides.title: RIGHT JOIN [[likho]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name,
  o.order_id, o.amount
FROM customers c
RIGHT JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;

slides.title: Har [[order]] aaya
slides.note: Order 104 ka customer 7 **mila hi nahi** → naam NULL. Ghost order 👻

slides.title: Wahi query, [[LEFT]] se
slides.code:
SELECT c.name,
  o.order_id, o.amount
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN customers c
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;
slides.note: Isliye log LEFT hi likhte: **main table pehle**, padhna easy 📖

slides.title: Support ka [[scene]]
points: Purane SQLite mein: tables swap + LEFT
slides.note: Ek query mein LEFT aur RIGHT **mix mat karo**. Dimaag ka dahi 🥴

slides.wrong:
Socha **customers** ki saari rows aayengi
(FROM customers RIGHT JOIN orders)
slides.right: RIGHT JOIN = **JOIN ke baad** wali table (orders) ki saari rows
slides.why: LEFT/RIGHT = **likhne ka order**, table ka naam nahi
